tagline.en: Travel eSIM with a free 1GB/7-day trial for new users across 33 European countries and Asian destinations
tagline.zh: 新用户免费领 1GB/7 天试用 eSIM，覆盖欧洲 33 国与亚洲多地

description.en: co:sim (operated by Comsand Inc., Wilmington, DE, USA) is a travel eSIM service covering 200+ destinations. Its standout offer is a free eSIM for new users: a 1 GB / 7-day trial covering 33 European countries as one regional bundle, with separate free allocations for Turkey, Moldova, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Japan, Thailand, South Korea and Hong Kong. The trial requires $0 at checkout but card verification, and installation QR codes are delivered by email. Top-ups are available anytime, payments run through Stripe, and uninstalled purchases qualify for self-service refunds within 30 days.
description.zh: co:sim（运营方为美国特拉华州注册的 Comsand Inc.）是覆盖 200+ 目的地的旅行 eSIM 服务。最大卖点是新人免费 eSIM：1GB/7 天试用，欧洲 33 国打包通用，土耳其、摩尔多瓦、新加坡、马来西亚、印尼、日本、泰国、韩国、香港各有单独免费额度。结账 $0 但需验卡，安装二维码通过邮件发送，可随时充值。支付走 Stripe，未安装的订单支持 30 天自助退款。

plansNote.en: Free-trial terms verified on cosim.io/en/free-esim (2026-10-12): $0 at checkout, card verification, new users only. Operator per site footer: Comsand Inc., 800 N King Street, Wilmington, DE. The provider is young with a short operating history — treat the free trial as a try-before-you-buy, not a long-term number.

details.en:
## How the free trial works

Claim the free eSIM on cosim.io/en/free-esim with an email address — community guides recommend mainstream providers (Outlook/Gmail/Yahoo) over disposable inboxes, as throwaway addresses tend to fail verification. The site emails an installation QR code; scan it to install the profile, then top up in-app if you need more data. The Europe allocation works as one 33-country bundle, while Japan, Hong Kong, South Korea, Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Turkey and Moldova each get their own allocation.

## What to watch for

Card verification is required even at $0 checkout, so a valid card is a hard prerequisite. Hotspot/tethering behavior is not documented officially. As a newer operator, long-term reliability is unproven — the 30-day refund only applies to purchases that were never installed, not to used trials.
details.zh:
## 免费试用怎么领

在 cosim.io/en/free-esim 用邮箱领取——社区实测建议用 Outlook/Gmail/Yahoo 等主流邮箱，一次性临时邮箱容易过不了验证。官网会把安装二维码发到邮箱，扫码写入 eSIM，需要更多流量时在站内充值。欧洲 33 国是一个打包额度，日本、香港、韩国、泰国、新加坡、马来西亚、印尼、土耳其、摩尔多瓦各有单独额度。

## 注意事项

$0 结账也要验卡，没有有效银行卡领不了。热点/共享官方未说明。平台较新，长期可靠性未经时间验证——30 天退款只覆盖未安装的付费订单，已使用的试用不退。
